verdict.rationale: Riveter's docs show scraping a single URL to text (docs-3), plus an agent-based enrichment that can chain multi-page lookups in one request (e.g., 'find every dental practice in a city, then pull every dentist from each one, in a single request' — docs-16) and extract from 'complicated websites' (docs-26). This supports multi-page, agent-driven data gathering but never describes a dedicated 'crawl the whole site' or sitemap-traversal endpoint that guarantees full-site coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit full-site crawl/sitemap feature, guarantees of covering every page, and independent evidence of successful whole-site crawls.
